title: Verify Time Clock navigation shows only Work Orders and Schedule as view-only
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Time Clock role. (per spec v39 amendment: Time Clock has Work Orders = View and Schedule = View; everything else is Off).
steps:
1. Look at the main navigation and note every visible entry.
2. Open Work Orders (if visible) and confirm it is view-only.
3. Open Schedule (if visible) and confirm it is view-only.
4. Look for Customers, Parts, Reports, and Settings.
expected:
Step 1: Only Work Orders and Schedule appear (per spec v39).
Step 2: Work Orders opens in view-only mode - no create/edit/delete actions available.
Step 3: Schedule opens in view-only mode.
Step 4: Customers, Parts, Reports, and Settings are all hidden.
